newsitem.title: CANADA: Alpine to buy Argentina oil service firm.
newsitem.headline: Alpine to buy Argentina oil service firm.

text.p: Alpine Oil Services Corp said on Tuesday it agreed to acquire all the shares of Argentine oil service and supply firm Alpha Oil Services SA for an undisclosed sum.

Neuquen, Argentina-based Alpha, which provides well abandonment services, pumping unit maintenance and tool rentals and repairs, had revenues of US$3 million in the year ended July 31, compared to US$2 million in fiscal 1996, Alpine said.
Alpine said it estimated Alpha's revenue would surpass US$3.5 million in 1998.
Alpha has long-term contracts with YPF SA, Alpine said, adding it expected to expand in Argentina by building on Alpha's contacts in the country and optimizing inventory.
